title: File Manager Engine service atlas
status: OBSERVED source inventory with DECIDED boundaries and explicitly labeled open gates
summary: A source-adjacent map of the Go search/index backend: public contract, service coordination, exact catalogue, durable generations, bounded live traversal, observation, candidate similarity, transport, and verification.
boundaries: The filesystem is authoritative; catalogue and index state are projections.
Public engine operations never mutate source files.
Exact identity and stored records remain authoritative over candidate channels.
JSONL is the development and conformance projection; the M4 dogfood service uses authenticated bounded local framing.
Semantic interpretation and personal memory remain Orchestrator-managed concerns outside this engine.
A damaged or absent engine may reduce search capability but must not disable navigation.

layers.name: Entry and projection
layers.status: OBSERVED development JSONL and M4-only installed local projections
layers.responsibility: Validate explicit sandbox or host-bound manifest authority, construct the service, and project semantic requests without importing catalogue representation into the wire contract.

layers.name: Public semantic contract
layers.status: ORC-ENG semantic v0 frozen for experimental implementation
layers.responsibility: Transport-neutral requests, responses, status, capability, lifecycle, evidence, and machine-readable faults.

layers.name: Service coordination
layers.status: OBSERVED development service and M4-only installed authenticated projection
layers.responsibility: Coordinate lifecycle, configuration, approved roots, reconciliation, checked readers, exact/live query, currentness, and optional experimental channels.

layers.name: Exact projection
layers.responsibility: Observe platform objects and bindings, enforce root ownership, publish immutable reference snapshots, answer bounded exact queries, and preserve exact evidence.

layers.name: Durable projection
layers.status: OBSERVED M2 immutable-generation candidate; final live tiered publication remains open
layers.responsibility: Publish and recover checked immutable components, pin readers, preserve rejected evidence, and host unadmitted delta/tiered experiments behind the exact oracle.

layers.name: Catalogue-independent query
layers.status: OBSERVED ORC-ENG-004 development slice; cross-platform promotion gates remain open
layers.responsibility: Perform bounded metadata-only live traversal with expiring cursors, exact observed identity, explicit partial state, and no catalogue writes.

layers.name: Incremental observation
layers.status: OBSERVED experimental; coverage incomplete and watermark volatile
layers.responsibility: Convert native change hints into bounded coalesced reconciliation work without treating watcher events as authority.

layers.name: Similarity candidate channel
layers.status: OBSERVED disabled experimental Kolmogrov transfer slice
layers.responsibility: Propose bounded candidates anchored back to one exact generation; never own identity, relevance, or semantic memory.

layers.name: Safety and evidence
layers.status: OBSERVED fixtures, controls, and mandatory promotion evidence
layers.responsibility: Contain development roots, generate canonical workloads, compare controls, and retain measured or rejected results.

flows.name: Checked catalogue query
steps: JSONL request is decoded under the one-frame ceiling.
Service admits a lifecycle-counted query operation.
Approved-root snapshot and checked reader generation are pinned.
Exact planner applies scope, filters, order, candidate, and cursor bounds.
Ranking maps exact matches to evidence-bearing API results.
Response names generation, plan, cursor, staleness, and warnings.

flows.name: Authoritative reconcile and publication
steps: Administrative operation serializes behind the service admin lock.
Scanner traverses one approved root through the sandbox or manifest-bound capability.
Most-specific root ownership prunes independently approved child roots.
Unchanged durable state returns without a publication write.
Changed state publishes and validates a new immutable generation.
Reader swap retains old-generation safety and then preserves rejected recovery evidence.

flows.name: Zero-catalogue live query
steps: Service verifies the root is already approved and still resolves inside the sandbox.
Live manager creates or resumes one bounded, expiring scan session.
Traversal keeps bounded depth/open directories and never follows directory links.
Matched paths receive exact platform observations at read time.
Page returns discovery order, work counters, explicit unavailable paths, and no catalogue generation.

flows.name: Shutdown
steps: Lifecycle changes from ready to draining and rejects new work.
Service lifetime cancellation reaches admitted operations and background observation.
Shutdown waits for the bounded active-operation count to drain.
Live cursors and the current exact reader are closed.
State becomes stopped or faulted without writing a clean-stop marker.

protocol.purpose: Build, protocol, instance, contract, feature, and capability identity.
Lifecycle, roots, checked generation, currentness, work, capability, and warnings snapshot.
Enacted development configuration and stable compare-and-apply digest.
Bounded exact catalogue retrieval with evidence and generation-bound cursors.
Bounded name/path filesystem traversal without catalogue persistence.
Validate and canonicalize already-authorized roots without mutation.
Apply policy with a stale-configuration precondition; authorization is session-owned, not payload-owned.
Authoritative metadata scan and conditional exact publication.
Inspect exact integrity without implicit repair.
Force a checked authoritative replacement while retaining the last valid reader when possible.
Drain one process instance; restart remains supervisor-owned.
Bounded sequenced status replay; not implemented.

operations.name: Generate atlas
operations.outcome: Regenerates deterministic HTML, JavaScript manifest, and Markdown mirror under docs/library/.

operations.name: Check atlas
operations.outcome: Fails if checked-in documentation is stale or incomplete.

operations.name: Validate
operations.outcome: Runs unit tests, race detector, vet, cross-builds, documentation tests, and atlas freshness check.

operations.name: Install development artifact
operations.outcome: Installs the binary and static atlas without registering a native supervisor.

operations.name: Install M4 dogfood service
operations.outcome: Creates a host-bound manifest and bootstraps the exact per-user LaunchAgent on Apple silicon.

operations.name: Run safely
operations.outcome: Starts the JSONL development projection only after explicit containment is supplied.

filemanager/engine/api.status: ORC-ENG semantic v0 frozen for experimental implementation
filemanager/engine/api.summary: Transport-neutral requests, responses, evidence, lifecycle, capabilities, configuration, and safe fault vocabulary.
invariants: No storage representation crosses this package.
No source-file mutation operation exists.
Unrelated raw channel scores are not directly comparable.

filemanager/engine/cmd/fileman-engine.status: OBSERVED development and M4 dogfood host
filemanager/engine/cmd/fileman-engine.summary: Requires either an explicit development sandbox or an exact host-bound manifest, constructs one service, and selects JSONL or authenticated local transport.
invariants: No empty or ambient root default.
Installed roots come only from a validated manifest.

filemanager/engine/internal/deployment.summary: Validates same-uid 0600 manifests bound to Darwin host UUID, exact root object identity, exclusions, and private engine-owned state.
invariants: A manifest copied to another host or uid fails closed.
Root identity and canonical path are rechecked at every start.
Engine state remains outside indexed roots.

filemanager/engine/internal/transport.status: OBSERVED development JSONL and M4 authenticated local projections
filemanager/engine/internal/transport.summary: Decodes bounded requests, separates query/admin authorities, validates same-uid peers and rotated credentials, dispatches canonical methods, and redacts internal faults.
invariants: Every JSONL or ENG1 payload is capped at 1 MiB.
Transport contains no catalogue or ranking logic.
Query and admin endpoints cannot exchange authority.

filemanager/engine/internal/service.summary: The cohesive façade over lifecycle, configuration, capabilities, approved roots, reconciliation, checked readers, exact/live query, status, and experimental observation/similarity seams.
invariants: Administrative publication is serialized.
Queries pin one immutable reader generation.
Shutdown cancels and drains admitted work before closing readers.

filemanager/engine/internal/catalog.summary: Object-plus-binding algebra, immutable reference shards, root projections, canonical serialization, and exact integrity oracle.
invariants: Objects are distinct from path bindings.
Compact ordinals are generation-local.
Filesystem observations remain authoritative.

filemanager/engine/internal/identity.status: OBSERVED platform adapters with remaining promotion gates
filemanager/engine/internal/identity.summary: Typed platform identity and incarnation evidence for macOS, Linux, and Windows observations.
invariants: Paths are observed addresses, not identity.
Platform evidence is retained rather than collapsed into a false universal key.

filemanager/engine/internal/scan.summary: Capability-rooted authoritative traversal that produces exact catalogue shards without reading file contents or following directory symlinks.
invariants: Traversal stays beneath the explicit sandbox.
Source trees are read-only.

filemanager/engine/internal/ownership.summary: Routes each path to its most-specific approved root and prevents parent/child shard duplication.
invariants: An independently approved child root prunes the parent projection.

filemanager/engine/internal/exact.summary: Bounded exact candidates, metadata filters, deterministic sorting, inspection, and generation-bound cursors over reference or durable readers.
invariants: Candidate-budget overflow is an error, never silent truncation.
Cursors bind to generation and normalized query.

filemanager/engine/internal/ranking.summary: Maps exact matches and records into evidence-preserving result order without pretending later fusion is implemented.
invariants: Exact evidence remains named and reconstructable.

filemanager/engine/internal/generation.status: OBSERVED M2 candidate plus isolated experiments
filemanager/engine/internal/generation.summary: Checked immutable component files, dual manifests, pinned readers, recovery, quarantine, diffing, and unadmitted delta/tiered candidates.
invariants: Recovery selects one complete checked generation or fails closed.
Readers pin immutable files.
Storage layout is private and rebuildable.

filemanager/engine/internal/live.summary: Bounded metadata-only filesystem search with expiring process-local sessions, discovery-order pages, and explicit partial state.
invariants: No catalogue is created or consulted.
Directory links are returned but not traversed.
State is bounded by depth, sessions, work, results, time, and bytes.

filemanager/engine/internal/observation.summary: Native cursor model and bounded coalescer that converts hints, gaps, and overflow into authoritative reconciliation work.
invariants: Events are hints, never identity authority.
Gaps force reconciliation.
No durable per-event journal is introduced.

filemanager/engine/internal/observation/.status: OBSERVED experimental macOS adapter; coverage incomplete
filemanager/engine/internal/observation/.summary: FSEvents subscription projected into the portable cursor/batch model with explicit coverage limitation.
invariants: Incomplete final-hard-link removal coverage prevents an exact-current claim.

filemanager/engine/internal/observation/.status: OBSERVED compatibility slice; native NTFS promotion red
filemanager/engine/internal/observation/.summary: Windows ReadDirectoryChangesW subscription projected into the portable cursor/batch model.
invariants: Compatibility evidence is not native NTFS promotion evidence.

filemanager/engine/internal/similarity.summary: Versioned fixed-width history-tuple candidate addresses, checked component index, and exact one-edit verification.
invariants: Candidates resolve to exact generation anchors.
Hashes never own identity or relevance.
Public fuzzy query remains unavailable.

filemanager/engine/internal/sandbox.status: OBSERVED development and installed admission guards
filemanager/engine/internal/sandbox.summary: Canonical development containment plus immutable manifest id/path and exclusion enforcement for installed traversal.
invariants: No unsafe default, force flag, or environment bypass.
Installed administrative calls cannot widen manifest authority.

filemanager/engine/internal/workload.summary: Canonical generated logical corpora and digests shared by reference and control implementations.
invariants: Controls consume identical logical records and correctness digests.

filemanager/engine/benchmarks.status: MEASURED only where named result records exist
filemanager/engine/benchmarks.summary: Opt-in performance, durability, live-query, background-currentness, similarity, and mature-store control campaigns.
invariants: A benchmark is not a product claim without workload, environment, distribution, and scope of inference.
